oracle: Python float(text), checked by exact Decimal/Fraction neighbor distances and even ties

contract.layer: rhodes::control_text::parse_decimal (raw token; no whitespace or units)
contract.negative_values: accepted by this raw helper; controller range validation is separate
contract.zero: preserve literal sign; reject nonzero literals rounded to zero
contract.expected_bits: 16-digit hexadecimal binary64 encoding, or null for rejection
contract.midpoint_limit: Subnormal and smallest-normal exact ties exceed 127 characters; 110-significant-digit directed decimal brackets straddle their exact rational midpoints.
